sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Look at that.
sentences.zh: 看那个。

sentences.en: It's like those three houses all in a row are like a set of stairs.
sentences.zh: 那三栋连在一起的房子就像楼梯一样。

sentences.en: I love those moments when you're walking in your neighborhood and suddenly nothing is familiar.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那种走在街区里，突然觉得周围一切都变得陌生起来的时刻。

sentences.en: It's like a staircase for a giant.
sentences.zh: 就像巨人的楼梯。

sentences.en: I don't want to meet that giant.
sentences.zh: 我可不想遇见那个巨人。

sentences.en: Not that you don't know where you are, but where you are, where you've always been, seems foreign somehow.
sentences.zh: 并不是说你迷路了，而是你身处之地，那个你一直熟悉的地方，不知为何显得有些陌生。

sentences.en: In a good way.
sentences.zh: 一种奇妙的感觉。

sentences.en: I've never noticed this gym before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从没注意到这个健身房。

sentences.en: It's a beautiful little straight, low, boxy houses.
sentences.zh: 这些房子很漂亮，笔直、低矮、方方正正的。

sentences.en: It happened to Sean Cole, friend of the show, back in the spring.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·科尔，我们节目的朋友，他在春天也遇到过这种情况。

sentences.en: He lives in Brooklyn, up in the northern part, near Queens.
sentences.zh: 他住在布鲁克林，北边靠近皇后区的地方。

sentences.en: You know, Gallagher, the comedian, talks about when you have a kid and you start seeing the world with new eyes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，喜剧演员加拉格尔说过，当你有了孩子，你就会用全新的眼光去看待世界。

sentences.en: I was kind of seeing the world, my neighborhood, with new eyes.
sentences.zh: 我当时也正用全新的眼光看待这个世界，看待我所在的街区。

sentences.en: Except you don't have a kid.
sentences.zh: 但你并没有孩子。

sentences.en: I do not have a kid.
sentences.zh: 我确实没有孩子。

sentences.en: In my case, it was due to this artist that I was going to meet.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，是因为我要去见一位艺术家。

sentences.en: That's why I was walking through the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 这就是我走在街区里的原因。

sentences.en: And what's his name?
sentences.zh: 他叫什么名字？

sentences.en: His name is James Gulliver Hancock.
sentences.zh: 他叫詹姆斯·格列佛·汉考克。

sentences.en: Here we are.
sentences.zh: 我们到了。

sentences.en: He told me to meet him at this cafe not far from where I live called Cookie Road.
sentences.zh: 他让我去离我住处不远的一家叫“曲奇路”的咖啡馆见他。

sentences.en: Right on time.
sentences.zh: 非常准时。

sentences.en: And he goes, the old Cookie Road, though, not the new one on Manhattan Avenue.
sentences.zh: 他说的是老曲奇路，不是曼哈顿大道上那家新的。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking, what do you know about the new one?
sentences.zh: 我在想，你对那家新的了解多少？

sentences.en: You live in Australia.
sentences.zh: 你可是住在澳大利亚。

sentences.en: James, microphone in hand.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯，手里拿着麦克风。

sentences.en: Hey, how's it going?
sentences.zh: 嘿，最近怎么样？

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: It's good to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: But the thing about James Gulliver Hancock is that he just knows this city so intimately.
sentences.zh: 但詹姆斯·格列佛·汉考克最特别的地方在于，他对这座城市有着极其深入的了解。

sentences.en: He did used to live here from about 2010 to 2012.
sentences.zh: 他确实在2010年到2012年左右住在这里。

sentences.en: And back when he lived here, and this is why I was going to meet him, back when he lived
sentences.zh: 当他住在这里时——这也是我来见他的原因——当他住在这里时，

sentences.en: here, he started this pretty obsessive little project that ultimately culminated in a book.
sentences.zh: 他开始了一个相当执着的小项目，最终汇集成了一本书。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I have the book.
sentences.zh: 没错，我有这本书。

sentences.en: Oh, great.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: And the name of the book.
sentences.zh: 关于这本书的名字。

sentences.en: I have to say, I love the title.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，我喜欢这个标题。

sentences.en: It's so earneSt.
sentences.zh: 它非常真诚。

sentences.en: Is All the Buildings in New York.
sentences.zh: 叫《纽约的所有建筑》。

sentences.en: All the Buildings in New York that I've Drawn So Far.
sentences.zh: 《我目前画过的纽约所有建筑》。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's like what a six-year-old would call it.
sentences.zh: 听起来就像六岁小孩起的名字。

sentences.en: That's what I like about it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我喜欢它的地方。

sentences.en: Is that what it was?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's naive.
sentences.zh: 是的，很天真。

sentences.en: It implies that you're going to draw more.
sentences.zh: 它暗示着你还会画更多。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Buildings.
sentences.zh: 建筑。

sentences.en: I like the first part of the title the moSt.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢标题的前半部分。

sentences.en: So he's saying he wants to draw all the buildings in New York?
sentences.zh: 所以他是说他想画完纽约所有的建筑？

sentences.en: I think he would like to.
sentences.zh: 我想他是想的。

sentences.en: How many buildings are there in New York?
sentences.zh: 纽约有多少栋建筑？

sentences.en: 900,000 buildings.
sentences.zh: 90万栋。

sentences.en: Are there 900,000 buildings?
sentences.zh: 真的有90万栋吗？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是吧。

sentences.en: Maybe just on Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 也许只是曼哈顿的。

sentences.en: You would probably need to spend a lot more time here.
sentences.zh: 那你可能需要在这里花更多时间。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I actually looked this up later.
sentences.zh: 我后来确实查了一下。

sentences.en: In the New York City Property Tax Annual Report of 2011, it said there were 1,030,202 parcels,
sentences.zh: 在2011年的纽约市房产税年度报告中，显示有1,030,202个地块，

sentences.en: but I think parcels also include separate condominium and rental units.
sentences.zh: 但我认为地块也包括了独立的公寓和出租单元。

sentences.en: And then I found myself on the website of something called Emporus, which bills itself as a global
sentences.zh: 然后我在一个叫Emporus的网站上发现，它自称是全球

sentences.en: provider of building information.
sentences.zh: 建筑信息提供商。

sentences.en: And the number it said was closer to 728,452.
sentences.zh: 它给出的数字更接近728,452。

sentences.en: Closer to that.
sentences.zh: 接近那个数。

sentences.en: Close.
sentences.zh: 差不多。

sentences.en: Roughly.
sentences.zh: 大致如此。

sentences.en: In the book, there are only about 170, most of them in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 书里只有大约170栋，大部分在曼哈顿。

sentences.en: But you'd also draw around here in Brooklyn and everywhere, the Queens and the Bronx and
sentences.zh: 但你也会在布鲁克林、皇后区、布朗克斯以及其他地方画画，

sentences.en: the boroughs and the places.
sentences.zh: 各个行政区和各种地方。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Try to mix it up a bit.
sentences.zh: 尽量多样化一点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's hit every borough except Staten Island, though he did draw the ferry.
sentences.zh: 他画遍了每个行政区，除了斯塔滕岛，尽管他画过那里的渡轮。

sentences.en: And despite the title, these are not all the buildings in New York that he's drawn so far.
sentences.zh: 尽管标题这么写，但这并不是他目前画过的所有纽约建筑。

sentences.en: The book is just a sampling of his blog of the same name.
sentences.zh: 这本书只是他同名博客的一个精选集。

sentences.en: Actually, the blog is just called All the Buildings in New York.
sentences.zh: 其实，博客的名字就叫《纽约的所有建筑》。

sentences.en: Without the that I've drawn so far.
sentences.zh: 没有“我目前画过的”那部分。

sentences.en: Without the that I've drawn so far, yes.
sentences.zh: 没有“我目前画过的”，是的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because it's ongoing, you know.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个持续进行的项目，你知道的。

sentences.en: There's about 500 drawings on it, something like that.
sentences.zh: 上面大约有500幅画，差不多吧。

sentences.en: Some of them are just black and white wiggly sketches.
sentences.zh: 有些只是黑白的潦草素描。

sentences.en: Others are these really loving colored treatments with all kinds of intricate details.
sentences.zh: 另一些则是非常用心的彩色作品，有着各种错综复杂的细节。

sentences.en: Just one per page, mostly.
sentences.zh: 大部分是一页一幅。

sentences.en: The way a little kid draws superheroes.
sentences.zh: 就像小孩子画超级英雄那样。

sentences.en: The Empire State, the Chrysler, all the classics.
sentences.zh: 帝国大厦、克莱斯勒大厦，所有经典建筑。

sentences.en: But also all these anonymous down-at-the-heels ones.
sentences.zh: 但也包括那些默默无闻、破旧不堪的建筑。

sentences.en: Apartment houses, synagogue.
sentences.zh: 公寓楼、犹太教堂。

sentences.en: Rigorously labeled with the address 53 Pitt Street, 222 West 23rd Street.
sentences.zh: 严谨地标注着地址：皮特街53号，西23街222号。

sentences.en: Skyscraper, brownstone, massive, black, monolith.
sentences.zh: 摩天大楼、褐砂石建筑、巨大的黑色巨石。

sentences.en: But even the intricate drawings are still kind of cartoony.
sentences.zh: 但即使是那些复杂的画作，看起来也还是有点卡通感。

sentences.en: Little squiggles and dots hovering above the roofs as though the buildings are saying,
sentences.zh: 屋顶上方悬浮着小小的波浪线和圆点，仿佛建筑在说：

sentences.en: Look out!
sentences.zh: 小心！

sentences.en: Or maybe, ta-da!
sentences.zh: 或者可能是：当当！

sentences.en: I mean, why exactly?
sentences.zh: 我是说，为什么要这样？

sentences.en: Oh, right, yes, okay, so.
sentences.zh: 哦，对了，是的，好吧，是这样。

sentences.en: Well, I've done this project in different fashions in different cities.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在不同的城市用不同的方式做过这个项目。

sentences.en: So I've done all the rain in London and all the cars in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 我画过伦敦所有的雨，洛杉矶所有的车。

sentences.en: And all the bicycles in Berlin.
sentences.zh: 还有柏林所有的自行车。

sentences.en: But he was just passing through those cities, so he didn't dig in, like, with the buildings.
sentences.zh: 但他只是路过那些城市，所以没有像对待建筑那样深入挖掘。

sentences.en: It's like he would parachute into a place and immediately try to find its noun.
sentences.zh: 就像他空降到一个地方，然后立刻试图找到它的名词。

sentences.en: The thing that the city was about in some way.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，这个城市的核心所在。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, I mean, Berlin might not be about bikes for everyone, but when I was there, everyone had a bike and there were bikes all over the place.
sentences.zh: 我是说，柏林可能并不代表自行车，但我在那里时，每个人都有自行车，到处都是自行车。

sentences.en: So just focusing on one thing and getting to know that one thing about that place.
sentences.zh: 所以只专注于一件事，去了解那个地方的那一件事。

sentences.en: So trying to record it as obsessively as possible.
sentences.zh: 尽可能执着地记录下来。

sentences.en: But, yeah, New York was definitely the buildings.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，纽约绝对是关于建筑的。

sentences.en: And that's what I'm going to draw when I'm here.
sentences.zh: 这就是我在这里时要画的东西。

sentences.en: So I just started doing it and on it went.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始做了，然后就一直坚持了下来。

sentences.en: James and his wife moved home when she got pregnant so they could raise their kid in a place with more than one blade of grass sprouting from the ground.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯和妻子在他妻子怀孕时搬回了家，这样他们就能在一个草地不止长出一片叶子的地方抚养孩子。

sentences.en: I can't even enjoy a blade of grass unless I know there's a subway handy.
sentences.zh: 如果不知道附近有地铁，我连一片草叶都无法享受。

sentences.en: The book and the blog have gotten a fair amount of buzz.
sentences.zh: 这本书和博客引起了相当大的轰动。

sentences.en: A couple of big newspaper write-ups and a lot of mentions on the blogosphere.
sentences.zh: 几家大报纸的报道，以及博客圈里大量的提及。

sentences.en: Including one that, due to a glorious typo, said James is on a mission to draw on the buildings in New York.
sentences.zh: 其中一个因为一个光荣的拼写错误，说詹姆斯的目标是“在纽约的建筑上画画”。

sentences.en: A lot of the coverage really frames James as a kind of Don Quixote with a pen.
sentences.zh: 很多报道确实把詹姆斯塑造成了一个拿着笔的堂吉诃德。

sentences.en: Okay, so how's it going so far with your dream of painting all the buildings in New York?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么你画完纽约所有建筑的梦想进展如何？

sentences.en: It's going pretty well.
sentences.zh: 进展得相当顺利。

sentences.en: This is from a segment on Good Day Sacramento.
sentences.zh: 这是来自《萨克拉门托美好的一天》节目的一段片段。

sentences.en: They talk to James via Skype.
sentences.zh: 他们通过Skype采访了詹姆斯。

sentences.en: Now, this is New York.
sentences.zh: 现在，这是纽约。

sentences.en: It's a tough city.
sentences.zh: 这是一座艰难的城市。

sentences.en: Some people yell at you like, why are you painting my building?
sentences.zh: 有些人会冲你大喊，比如，你为什么画我的楼？

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 怎么回事？

sentences.en: No, it's more that it is New York, so people will let you do whatever you want, really.
sentences.zh: 不，更多是因为这是纽约，所以人们真的会让你做任何你想做的事。

sentences.en: You know, a guy drawing on the street is probably one of the most normal things you see.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一个人在街上画画可能是你见过的最正常的事情之一。

sentences.en: Go back the way we came and do it, right?
sentences.zh: 按原路返回去画，对吧？

sentences.en: There's plenty more weird things than that around.
sentences.zh: 周围还有更多奇怪的事情呢。

sentences.en: Because there's a building just on the corner that I've drawn a couple of times.
sentences.zh: 因为拐角处正好有一栋我画过几次的建筑。

sentences.en: And what I wanted to do with James was go to some of the buildings he'd drawn and hold up the drawing next to the building.
sentences.zh: 我想和詹姆斯做的是，去一些他画过的建筑前，把画和建筑放在一起对比。

sentences.en: Maybe to try to see what he sees.
sentences.zh: 也许是为了看看他看到了什么。

sentences.en: I'm only realizing this now, but you don't ever get to do that.
sentences.zh: 我现在才意识到，你从来没有机会这样做。

sentences.en: To sit with the artist in front of the thing that they made into a picture.
sentences.zh: 和艺术家一起坐在他们画成画的东西面前。

sentences.en: Look out.
sentences.zh: 小心。

sentences.en: There aren't a lot of Brooklyn buildings in the book, but I had my smartphone with me,
sentences.zh: 书里布鲁克林的建筑不多，但我带了智能手机，

sentences.en: so I figured we'd just call up his blog.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我们直接打开他的博客看看。

sentences.en: The first drawing on his blog is in Greenpoint, actually.
sentences.zh: 他博客上的第一幅画其实是在绿点区。

sentences.en: A little apartment complex at 587 Manhattan Avenue.
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿大道587号的一处小公寓楼。

sentences.en: It's one of the loose, shambly charcoal sketches.
sentences.zh: 那是那些松散、凌乱的炭笔素描之一。

sentences.en: Looks more like an idea for a building.
sentences.zh: 看起来更像是建筑的构思。

sentences.en: James uploaded that picture on May 20th, 2010.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯在2010年5月20日上传了那张照片。

sentences.en: He was still brand new to the city at that point,
sentences.zh: 那时他刚到这座城市，

sentences.en: and this was sort of his way of keeping a diary of his time here.
sentences.zh: 这算是他记录在这里生活的一种方式。

sentences.en: It also had the very real, pragmatic function of helping him get around town.
sentences.zh: 它还有一个非常现实、务实的功能，就是帮助他熟悉这座城市。

sentences.en: That was one idea for the project to map this place that I didn't know very well for myself
sentences.zh: 那是这个项目的一个初衷，通过画很多不同的地方，为自己绘制出我不怎么熟悉的地方的地图。

sentences.en: through drawing lots of different places.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是一种试图去包含……的努力吗？

sentences.en: I mean, was it an effort to sort of contain...
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是一种试图去包含……的努力吗？

sentences.en: I mean, like, I've lived here, I've only lived here two years, but I'm like, ah, I can't...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我住在这儿，虽然才住了两年，但我总觉得，啊，我没法……

sentences.en: Yeah, it's like, where do you start?
sentences.zh: 是啊，就像是，你从哪儿开始呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You can't take it all in.
sentences.zh: 你没法把一切都尽收眼底。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So was it where you're trying to, like, bring the city down to 8x11 size?
sentences.zh: 所以你是想把整座城市浓缩到一张 8x11 的纸上吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 对，对，完全是这样。

sentences.en: You get a much deeper understanding of the place.
sentences.zh: 你会对这个地方有更深刻的理解。

sentences.en: You don't just sit in front of the Chrysler Building and the Empire State, which I've done,
sentences.zh: 你不仅仅是坐在克莱斯勒大厦和帝国大厦前——虽然我也这么做过，

sentences.en: but you sit in front of Joe Bloggs' house on 5th Street or wherever it is, you know.
sentences.zh: 而是坐在第五街乔·布洛格斯家门前，或者随便哪儿，你懂的。

sentences.en: And in a way, those buildings then become as kind of special as the Chrysler.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，那些建筑也变得和克莱斯勒大厦一样特别了。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, exactly, yeah, as iconic, you know, I think.
sentences.zh: 是啊，没错，确实，我觉得它们一样具有标志性。

sentences.en: Like that, I've drawn that before, that grocery store with the three stories above it,
sentences.zh: 就像那个，我以前画过，那个有三层楼的杂货店，

sentences.en: and I think just that, that's just classic.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那简直太经典了。

sentences.en: He's pointing to 97 Franklin Street.
sentences.zh: 他指着富兰克林街 97 号。

sentences.en: We walk past it to Greenpoint Ave, plop down on a bench,
sentences.zh: 我们路过那里走到格林波因特大道，在长椅上坐下，

sentences.en: James takes my phone and scrolls back on the blog to another bodega
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯拿过我的手机，在博客上翻到另一家杂货店，

sentences.en: across the street from where we're sitting.
sentences.zh: 就在我们对面。

sentences.en: Well, there's this one just there, the deli down the bottom.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就在那儿，底下的那家熟食店。

sentences.en: It's a similar one to the one we were talking about before.
sentences.zh: 和我们刚才聊的那家差不多。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: Oh, look at that.
sentences.zh: 哦，你看那个。

sentences.en: So that one's a bit different, it's a bit messy.
sentences.zh: 那个有点不一样，稍微有点乱。

sentences.en: You've really captured it.
sentences.zh: 你真的把它画得神形兼备。

sentences.en: I mean, I have to say it's like...
sentences.zh: 我是说，我得说这就像是……

sentences.en: Well, it's a quirky version of it, you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个古怪的版本，你知道的。

sentences.en: It's like, that's what I like about drawing.
sentences.zh: 这就是我喜欢画画的原因。

sentences.en: Like, it's not exactly...
sentences.zh: 就像，它并不完全是……

sentences.en: Like, I might have missed a few things, and like, this isn't actually that.
sentences.zh: 我可能漏掉了一些细节，而且，这其实并不是那个样子。

sentences.en: That's a bit further over, the bit down the middle.
sentences.zh: 中间那部分其实还要再往那边一点。

sentences.en: So it's all sort of a bit...
sentences.zh: 所以一切都有点……

sentences.en: The windows down the middle.
sentences.zh: 中间的那些窗户。

sentences.en: Wabi-sabi, you know.
sentences.zh: 侘寂之美，你懂的。

sentences.en: It's a bit organic.
sentences.zh: 有点自然随性的感觉。

sentences.en: And it's almost like you've made it more what it is.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉你把它表现得比实际更具神韵了。

sentences.en: Yeah, you bring out its character a bit.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你把它的性格突显出来了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I can pull up this one, too.
sentences.zh: 我还能翻出这一张。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，对，对。

sentences.en: This is 144 Franklin Street, an older, three-level apartment building
sentences.zh: 这是富兰克林街 144 号，一栋老式三层公寓楼，

sentences.en: that's lavished with all kinds of intricate design frills.
sentences.zh: 上面装饰着各种错综复杂的精致花纹。

sentences.en: It's one of those places that makes you think two things.
sentences.zh: 这地方总让人想到两件事。

sentences.en: One, who decided that this building, out of all of the buildings on this block,
sentences.zh: 第一，是谁决定在这条街的所有建筑中，

sentences.en: should be so crazily ornate?
sentences.zh: 唯独这栋楼要装饰得如此疯狂？

sentences.en: And two, you know, they just don't build places like that anymore.
sentences.zh: 第二，你知道，现在的人再也不会盖这样的房子了。

sentences.en: Do you know architectural terms?
sentences.zh: 你懂建筑术语吗？

sentences.en: What do you call, like, that sort of filigree, you know,
sentences.zh: 你管那种花丝装饰叫什么，你知道的，

sentences.en: the flowers that repeat going across the frieze up top?
sentences.zh: 就是顶部横梁上那些重复的花纹？

sentences.en: I'm talking straight out of my bottom here.
sentences.zh: 我这纯粹是在胡说八道。

sentences.en: I mean, I know the top part is like a cornice, right?
sentences.zh: 我是说，我知道顶部那部分叫檐口，对吧？

sentences.en: Cornice.
sentences.zh: 檐口。

sentences.en: But that's the funny thing.
sentences.zh: 但这就是有趣的地方。

sentences.en: Because I'm doing this largely architectural project,
sentences.zh: 因为我主要是在做这个建筑项目，

sentences.en: I constantly get asked about architecture,
sentences.zh: 我经常被问到关于建筑的问题，

sentences.en: and I haven't trained in architecture,
sentences.zh: 但我并没有受过建筑学训练，

sentences.en: and I don't know the terms outside of the standard terms that everyone knows.
sentences.zh: 除了大家都知道的标准术语外，我什么都不懂。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's hard to say what those things are.
sentences.zh: 所以，很难说清那些东西是什么。

sentences.en: I just appreciate them and draw them and show them to others.
sentences.zh: 我只是欣赏它们，把它们画下来，展示给别人看。

sentences.en: I mean, I'd never have noticed them if he hadn't drawn them
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果不是他画出来，

sentences.en: or if I wasn't sitting there with him.
sentences.zh: 或者我没和他坐在一起，我永远都不会注意到它们。

sentences.en: Sitting with James, it's like the whole city is a museum.
sentences.zh: 和詹姆斯坐在一起，感觉整座城市就像一座博物馆。

sentences.en: Usually, you know, buildings are too big or too cookie-cutter to notice,
sentences.zh: 通常，你知道，建筑要么太大，要么太千篇一律，让人注意不到，

sentences.en: but because he's drawing every window, every fire escape railing,
sentences.zh: 但因为他画了每一扇窗户、每一个防火梯栏杆，

sentences.en: he's eventually going to hit the funny little decisions or awkwardnesses
sentences.zh: 他最终总会捕捉到那些有趣的小细节或笨拙之处，

sentences.en: that make that building that building that nobody would notice otherwise.
sentences.zh: 正是这些让那栋建筑变得独特，否则没人会注意到。

sentences.en: James used to have a studio in the old pencil factory just half a block down.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯以前在半个街区外的旧铅笔厂有个工作室。

sentences.en: The pencil factory is funny, actually.
sentences.zh: 铅笔厂其实挺有意思的。

sentences.en: The top of it all the way around is appointed with these pencils.
sentences.zh: 它的顶部四周装饰着这些铅笔。

sentences.en: They're vertical.
sentences.zh: 它们是竖着的。

sentences.en: It's like an incomplete crown going around the top story,
sentences.zh: 就像一个不完整的皇冠绕着顶层，

sentences.en: just in case you forgot what they were making in there.
sentences.zh: 以防你忘了他们在那儿生产什么。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like a 15—these are 15-foot-long pencils.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这就像是 15 英尺长的铅笔。

sentences.en: They're like pencils for a giant.
sentences.zh: 就像巨人的铅笔一样。

sentences.en: That's the second time you've mentioned giants.
sentences.zh: 这是你第二次提到巨人了。

sentences.en: Thank you for keeping track.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你帮我记着。

sentences.en: I've drawn a few on the roof of the building.
sentences.zh: 我在楼顶画过几支。

sentences.en: We can get up there if you want to look.
sentences.zh: 如果你想看的话，我们可以上去。

sentences.en: Can we?
sentences.zh: 我们可以吗？

sentences.en: Oh, I'd love to.
sentences.zh: 哦，我很乐意。

sentences.en: I hope it's open, but we can try.
sentences.zh: 希望门没锁，我们可以试试。

sentences.en: Well, let's try, yeah.
sentences.zh: 好吧，试试看，好。

sentences.en: We duck around the corner into this warehouse-y-looking lobby
sentences.zh: 我们拐过街角，走进这个看起来像仓库的大厅，

sentences.en: and go right up to the top floor.
sentences.zh: 直接上到顶楼。

sentences.en: I love these old elevators.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这些老式电梯。

sentences.en: We jog around to the stairwell,
sentences.zh: 我们快步走到楼梯间，

sentences.en: and James stops at a window for a second to point something out to me,
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯在窗边停了一下，指给我看一个东西，

sentences.en: the weirdest thing.
sentences.zh: 最奇怪的东西。

sentences.en: Just under the roofs on the buildings across the street
sentences.zh: 就在街对面建筑的屋檐下，

sentences.en: are stenciled the address numbers of those buildings.
sentences.zh: 用模板喷漆印着那些建筑的门牌号。

sentences.en: See the numbers up at all?
sentences.zh: 看到上面的数字了吗？

sentences.en: Uh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Just there, above where it says bar.
sentences.zh: 就在那儿，写着酒吧的上方。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，看到了。

sentences.en: Oh, how about that?
sentences.zh: 哦，那怎么样？

sentences.en: It's really cute.
sentences.zh: 真的很可爱。

sentences.en: You would never know.
sentences.zh: 你永远都不会发现。

sentences.en: It's like, who is that for, a giant?
sentences.zh: 就像是，这是给谁看的，给巨人看的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, just walking down the street.
sentences.zh: 是啊，走在街上就能看到。

sentences.en: What is up with you, a giant?
sentences.zh: 你怎么回事，巨人吗？

sentences.en: Anyway, so...
sentences.zh: 总之，所以……

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: It's pretty cool up here.
sentences.zh: 这上面真酷。

sentences.en: It's amazing up here.
sentences.zh: 这上面太棒了。

sentences.en: 360-degree view of Manhattan and Brooklyn and Queens.
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿、布鲁克林和皇后区的 360 度全景。

sentences.en: This is like a helipad.
sentences.zh: 这简直像个直升机停机坪。

sentences.en: It's a huge roof,
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的屋顶，

sentences.en: and one of the iconic water towers on top that I love.
sentences.zh: 上面还有我最喜欢的那种标志性水塔。

sentences.en: So, yeah, the Empire State, the Chrysler,
sentences.zh: 所以，你看，帝国大厦、克莱斯勒大厦，

sentences.en: all the classics over there.
sentences.zh: 那边所有的经典建筑。

sentences.en: You know what's crazy?
sentences.zh: 你知道最疯狂的是什么吗？

sentences.en: Like, now that I'm looking at the skyline from up here,
sentences.zh: 现在从这儿俯瞰天际线，

sentences.en: I mean, it feels like,
sentences.zh: 我是说，感觉就像，

sentences.en: because I spent so much time looking at your drawings,
sentences.zh: 因为我花了太多时间看你的画，

sentences.en: it feels like I'm looking at a drawing as opposed to reality.
sentences.zh: 感觉我是在看一幅画，而不是现实。

sentences.en: The vibrations?
sentences.zh: 那些震动感？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: The wiggly lines?
sentences.zh: 那些歪歪扭扭的线条？

sentences.en: I see someone's perspective.
sentences.zh: 我看到了某人的视角。

sentences.en: That's what I see.
sentences.zh: 这就是我看到的。

sentences.en: I see someone else's perspective.
sentences.zh: 我看到了别人的视角。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I've tainted your eyes.
sentences.zh: 我玷污了你的双眼。

sentences.en: Damn you.
sentences.zh: 该死的。

sentences.en: You're going to see everything is quaint.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得一切都古色古香。

sentences.en: I never thought I'd see this city as quaint.
sentences.zh: 我从没想过我会觉得这座城市古色古香。

sentences.en: Everything's pastel.
sentences.zh: 一切都是柔和的色调。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, that's the thing about reading someone's diary,
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是读别人日记的感觉，

sentences.en: which is kind of what this is, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想这大概就是日记吧。

sentences.en: It's, you have a different view on the world afterwards.
sentences.zh: 看完之后，你对世界有了不同的看法。

sentences.en: Get inside someone's head.
sentences.zh: 走进某人的内心。

sentences.en: See their personal perspective.
sentences.zh: 看到他们个人的视角。

sentences.en: It just doesn't happen to be in words this time.
sentences.zh: 只是这次不是用文字表达的。

sentences.en: It's in pictures.
sentences.zh: 而是用图画。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，

sentences.en: I picked up the book again the other day and just leafing through it for a minute and then walking outside to the street and looking up at the buildings I look up at all the time and kind of hate.
sentences.zh: 前几天我又拿起那本书翻了一会儿，然后走到街上，抬头看着那些我平时总看、甚至有点讨厌的建筑。

sentences.en: Now, I don't know how else to say this.
sentences.zh: 现在，我不知道该怎么说。

sentences.en: It's like they seemed fun all of a sudden and kind of carefully.
sentences.zh: 它们突然看起来很有趣，而且很用心。

sentences.en: It's like now they were these carefully made objects.
sentences.zh: 就像现在它们变成了精心制作的艺术品。

sentences.en: I mean, you know that when you see the care that someone put into something and the genius of everyday decisions, I think it makes you almost pathologically optimistic.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当你看到某人倾注其中的心血，看到那些日常决策中的天才之处时，我觉得这会让你变得近乎病态地乐观。

sentences.en: Somebody put care into this.
sentences.zh: 有人用心对待了这些东西。

sentences.en: The world is better because of it.
sentences.zh: 世界因此变得更美好了。

sentences.en: And I think that that kind of optimism feeds James.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那种乐观精神滋养了詹姆斯。

sentences.en: I mean, it's funny that you say that because, like, I've been wondering, like, why is he such a happy person?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你说得很有趣，因为我一直在想，为什么他是一个如此快乐的人？

sentences.en: But I think that's why.
sentences.zh: 但我认为原因就在这儿。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Though I will say that he had a pessimistic little moment there on the roof because, of course, he's not just looking at the city.
sentences.zh: 虽然我得说，他在屋顶上确实有过那么一小会儿悲观的时刻，因为当然，他不仅仅是在看这座城市。

sentences.en: He's looking at the impossible job he's carved out for himself.
sentences.zh: 他正注视着自己为自己设定的那项不可能完成的任务。

sentences.en: Makes me anxious that I can't do it all.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到焦虑，因为我无法完成所有这些。

sentences.en: You know, you look here at this amazing view and there's like that one.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你看着这绝美的景色时，就像那一座建筑一样。

sentences.en: Look at that, the seaplane's taking off.
sentences.zh: 看那儿，水上飞机起飞了。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太惊人了。

sentences.en: But that one over there, the sort of Rosemary's Baby Ghostbusters style on the brown with the creamy brickwork up the top decorative with the green copper roofing.
sentences.zh: 但那边那一座，那种《罗斯玛丽的婴儿》遇上《捉鬼敢死队》风格的建筑，棕色墙面，顶部有奶油色砖饰，还有绿色的铜屋顶。

sentences.en: I don't know what that is.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: I've never been there, but it makes me anxious that I might not get there.
sentences.zh: 我从没去过那里，但这让我很焦虑，担心自己可能没法去到那里。

sentences.en: I want to do it.
sentences.zh: 我想去画它。

sentences.en: I want to draw that one.
sentences.zh: 我想画那一座。

sentences.en: Makes you anxious.
sentences.zh: 这会让你感到焦虑。

sentences.en: Why exactly?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢？

sentences.en: Because I want to spend time drawing all of the different buildings.
sentences.zh: 因为我想花时间把所有不同的建筑都画下来。

sentences.en: I mean, especially when I'm crossing a bridge, you see the lie of the land and you remember the name of the project and you want to do it, you know?
sentences.zh: 我是说，特别是在过桥的时候，你看到地势，记起项目的名字，就想把它画下来，你懂吗？

sentences.en: The nine-year-old in me wants to just, let's do this.
sentences.zh: 我内心那个九岁的孩子只想说，咱们开始吧。

sentences.en: But what would it mean if you don't get to all of them or don't get to the ones that you want to do?
sentences.zh: 但如果你没能画完所有建筑，或者没能画完你想画的那些，那意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Die an unhappy death.
sentences.zh: 带着遗憾死去吧。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Do I force my son to start drawing them?
sentences.zh: 我要强迫我儿子开始画它们吗？

sentences.en: There you go.
sentences.zh: 就这样吧。

sentences.en: Carry on the legacy?
sentences.zh: 继承衣钵？

sentences.en: Yeah, it'll be a legacy.
sentences.zh: 是啊，这会成为一种传承。

sentences.en: It'll be generations and generations of Hancocks.
sentences.zh: 这将是汉考克家族一代又一代的传承。

sentences.en: He's probably going to be an accountant, though.
sentences.zh: 不过他很可能会成为一名会计师。

sentences.en: Why do you say that?
sentences.zh: 为什么这么说？

sentences.en: He's won.
sentences.zh: 他赢了。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Is he already doing maths?
sentences.zh: 他已经在学数学了吗？

sentences.en: His mom's a performer and his dad's a drawer.
sentences.zh: 他妈妈是表演者，他爸爸是画画的。

sentences.en: Oh, I see.
sentences.zh: 哦，我明白了。

sentences.en: So he's going to rebel.
sentences.zh: 所以他会叛逆。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, he may be a politician.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他可能会成为一名政治家。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: He can do it every once.
sentences.zh: 他随时都可以做。

sentences.en: That's a good dad.
sentences.zh: 那是个好爸爸。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I love being a dad.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢当爸爸。

sentences.en: It's great.
sentences.zh: 感觉很棒。

sentences.en: Do you?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I've thought about it.
sentences.zh: 我考虑过这件事。

sentences.en: I've only thought about it.
sentences.zh: 我也只是考虑过而已。

sentences.en: Yeah, don't think too hard.
sentences.zh: 是啊，别想太多。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Sean Cole, our own Sean Cole, Sam Greenspan, and
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由肖恩·科尔（Sean Cole）、我们自己的肖恩·科尔、萨姆·格林斯潘（Sam Greenspan）以及

sentences.en: me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我，罗曼·马尔斯（Roman Mars）制作。

sentences.en: And we have a new intern.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一位新实习生。

sentences.en: Her name is Avery Truffleman.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫艾弗里·特鲁夫曼（Avery Truffleman）。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 Local Public Radio KALW in San Francisco and the American Institute
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 91.7 本地公共广播电台 KALW 和美国建筑师协会

sentences.en: of Architects in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 旧金山分会的一个合作项目。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到并点赞我们的节目。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars, but right now you go to 99pi.org and you can look at amazing pictures
sentences.zh: 我的推特账号是 Roman Mars，但现在你可以访问 99pi.org，查看我目前画的所有

sentences.en: of all the buildings in New York I've drawn so far.
sentences.zh: 纽约建筑的精美图片。

sentences.en: Why are you painting my building?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要画我的建筑？

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 怎么回事？

sentences.en: That's 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 网址是 99percentinvisible.org。

sentences.en: Radiotopia.
sentences.zh: Radiotopia。
